release: LGAE v5.3.2 — Research improvements: Q-learning, hierarchical retrieval, gauge norm control
test_note: Full suite passes in a single pytest invocation (~20s) from the installed wheel (no PYTHONPATH override). +56 new tests for v5.3.2 research and safety improvements.

policy_qualification.note: The original supervised policy gate remains at 83.3%. The new Q(S,a) controller (scripts/train_q_controller.py) achieves 86% accuracy on held-out topology families, a significant improvement over the supervised policy's 30%.

q_controller.approach: Q(S,a) = E[ΔU(S,a)] trained on 14400 counterfactual outcomes across 8 topology families
q_controller.note: The Q-network does better on held-out families than in-distribution because some in-distribution families (star, cycle) have zero ΔU for all actions, making the correct action ambiguous. Wheel and caveman have clearer structural interventions.

research_improvements.graph_feature_baseline: Replaced GraphHashBaseline with GraphFeatureBaseline (online ridge regression on 16-dim structural features). Similar graph states now produce similar baseline predictions, reducing variance in advantage estimation.
research_improvements.hierarchical_candidate_retrieval: Replaced top-24 node candidate generation with top-64 + latent-distance KNN retrieval (4 neighbors per node, 512 max pairs). Correct endpoints outside the top-64 are now reachable via KNN.
research_improvements.dynamic_gauge_norm_clamping: Added generator Frobenius norm clamping (default max=1.0) after antisymmetrization. Prevents Cayley conditioning problems and bounds the Jacobian of the state-dependent gauge map. Spectral norm available as opt-in.
research_improvements.equilibrium_barrier_upgrade: Upgraded from pure state-delta to combined state-delta + dynamics residual. Now checks ||F(z_t) - z_t|| / ||z_t|| in addition to ||z_t - z_{t-1}|| / ||z_{t-1}||, catching periodic orbits and metastable plateaus that the old check missed.
research_improvements.counterfactual_dataset: New module generates (state, action, ΔU) triples across 8 topology families (path, cycle, grid, star, BA, WS, random, bipartite) with 3 held-out families (wheel, lollipop, caveman).
research_improvements.q_learning: Q(S,a) trained via MSE regression on counterfactual outcomes. Policy derived as argmax_a Q(S,a) instead of supervised action classification.
research_improvements.production_config: ProductionConfig() factory enables all hardening features (curvature_ema, equilibrium_barrier) and sets bounded safety thresholds. ResearchConfig() is the permissive default.
research_improvements.certification_levels: Governor now reports CERTIFIED_GLOBAL, SAMPLED_LOCAL, or HEURISTIC_PROXY in mutation result metadata, distinguishing full audits from sampled checks.
research_improvements.mutation_authority_levels: Mutations classified as REVERSIBLE (reweighting), STRUCTURAL (add/prune edges), or IRREVERSIBLE (fiber spawn/prune, gauge changes), enabling tiered evidence requirements.
research_improvements.scale_qualification: New script (scripts/scale_qualification.py) measures empirical complexity curves for diffusion, audit, mutation, and checkpoint operations across N=100 to N=3000.
research_improvements.checkpoint_merkle_root: Safe checkpoint format now includes a Merkle root over all checkpoint files, providing cryptographic provenance without requiring a trusted signature.
research_improvements.ed25519_receipt_signing: Receipt chain now supports optional Ed25519 signing (requires cryptography or PyNaCl). Signed receipts provide identity authentication in addition to tamper evidence.
research_improvements.bayesian_curvature_hysteresis: Curvature EMA upgraded from crude EWMA variance to Normal-Inverse-Gamma conjugate posterior with calibrated credible intervals and effective sample size.
research_improvements.information_gain_task: New Task G tests whether the executive's IG predictions correlate with actual information gain from exploratory mutations on hidden structural uncertainty.
research_improvements.tensor_native_topology: Added topology_signature_buffers() and find_bridges_buffers() that operate directly on GraphBuffers without NetworkX conversion. Governor bridge detection now uses tensor-native path.
research_improvements.torch_compile_qualification: New script measures eager vs compiled diffusion. Result: compiled is 0.05x speedup (slower) due to graph breaks from .item() calls and recompilation from step_index changes. Honest negative result.
research_improvements.model_predictive_control: New StructuralMPC class plans multi-step mutation sequences using shadow evaluation with receding horizon control. Bounded branching factor and sequence cap.
research_improvements.permutation_equivariant_executive: New EquivariantExecutiveNetwork uses message-passing GNN with mean pooling. Graph-level output is exactly permutation-invariant (verified to 1e-4).

torch_compile.architecture: fixed-shape sparse numerical kernels; eager discrete evolution
